+---
+## What
+`check agent` on a running run now gives only "is running: `lastEvent`", and `lastEvent` is not updated during a delivery turn. Make it a real, non-blocking progress view of the run's transcript.
+
+- The run already reads its session events: the `streamEvents` loop in `AgentRun.drive`, and `streamSessionEvents()` in `AgentRun+TurnLimit.swift` `dispatchCountingPasses`. Keep a live progress record on `AgentRun`, fed by both loops: the phase, the count of passes, the names of the last tool calls (a small fixed number), and the tail of the text so far (cut to a fixed number of characters).
+- Do not read `transcript.jsonl` (the guard tests forbid file I/O in `Sources`). Do not read `RoutedSession.transcript` (it takes the turn lock and waits for the turn).
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRunProgress.swift` (the record and its text), and change `Run/AgentRun+FinalMessage.swift` `report(of:)` for `.running`. Remove `AgentRunActivity` if the progress record replaces it.
+- The answer for a finished, failed, or cancelled run does not change.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `check agent` on a run in its task turn gives the phase, the pass count, the last tool names, and the text tail.
+- [ ] During a delivery turn, `check agent` shows the delivery phase and the new passes.
+- [ ] `check agent` returns at once while the run's turn holds the model (a gated scripted turn).
+- [ ] No code in `Sources` reads a transcript file or `RoutedSession.transcript` for this.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentRunProgressTests.swift`: the text of the record for each phase; the tool-name and text-tail limits.
+- [ ] Update `AgentsToolOperationsTests` and `AgentSchedulingTests` for the new running text.
+- [ ] Run `swift test -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
